correctness.rationale: Exact digit multiplication, one-digit exponent polynomial, trailing-four carry classification with the all-four boundary, and exhaustive last-digit cases prove the sixty-four-cell finite formula for every depth. Uniform aligned blocks yield the natural density and logarithmic-squared error. The standalone checker independently confirms integer residues, 384 finite histogram cells, 40 support words and rational marginal identities; finite checks are not the all-depth proof.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete next-order invariant of a classical modular sequence. It identifies twenty-four globally impossible consecutive triples despite asymptotically uniform adjacent pairs, computes all forty positive densities, identifies the sharp finite support onset and gives exact cutoff counts with quantified discrepancy. The higher-order obstruction is not visible from the known pairwise results and is mathematically motivated beyond a finite table.
